items.title: Analyzing the Cracking Behavior of Asphalt Mixtures Using Principal Component Analysis and K-Means Clustering
items.authors: Mehdi Sadeghi, Sina Mousavi Rad, & Mohamed Elkashef
items.abstract: Principal component analysis and K-means clustering are applied to IDEAL-CT results from 165 samples representing 33 plant-produced asphalt mixtures to identify distinct cracking-behavior groups.
